title: Synthetic two-day training draft
description: Dependency-free offline demonstration for A–D with fixed assignments, bounded feasibility, current-input review, and portable JSON recovery. No operational integrations or model-driven constraint decisions.

components.label: Synthetic input editor
components.description: Editable four requests, roster constraints, operating windows and fixed assignments; retains invalid values with field errors.

components.label: Validation and bounded feasibility core
components.description: Pure functions validate input, search explicit starts, enforce constraints and compute whole-horizon loads; four distinct outcomes.

components.label: Two-day board and conflict explanations
components.description: All requests remain visible; displays complete feasible draft or unresolved rows, personnel loads, diagnostic reasons and synthetic limitations.

components.label: Current-draft state and review
components.description: Input/result revisions clear review; person-selected allowed-start edits are independently validated. Human review remains separate from source approval.

components.label: Portable synthetic snapshot
components.description: Versioned JSON preserves exact inputs and draft; validated import, explicit re-review after import, no reconnect synchronization.

components.label: Local browser file transfer
components.description: Browser download and file picker only; local JSON transfer, no backend, calendar connector, identity provider or simulated operational connection.
